 "rationale": "PTAT current UT*ln8/R1 is about 5uA per branch, plus a 2uA follower and a 0.3uA start-up leg, for about 32uW. The follower lifts M2's drain about 0.7V above the PMOS gate. This avoids the M2 triode that a PMOS diode causes when |Vth| is 1V. R2/R1 of about 9.5 cancels the Veb slope. L=2 devices give line regulation of a few mV/V. A weak-pullup start-up inverter pulls the mirror on while vref is low."}

PARAMS = {
    "I":      (5e-6, 2e-6, 12e-6),   # PTAT branch current
    "k_r2":   (9.6, 7.5, 12.0),      # R2/R1
    "gmid_n": (18, 12, 24),          # level-shift NMOS pair
    "Ln":     (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),
    "gmid_p": (10, 7, 14),           # PMOS mirror
    "Lp":     (2.0, 1.0, 4.0),
    "I7":     (2e-6, 0.8e-6, 6e-6),  # follower bias
    "gmid_f": (16, 10, 22),          # follower NMOS
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    N = 8
    I = p["I"]
    dvbe = UT * math.log(N)
    R1 = dvbe / I
    R2 = p["k_r2"] * R1

    # Emitter voltage estimate (Q1/Q3 m=1)
    veb = 0.76 - UT * math.log(10e-6 / I)

    # NMOS level-shift pair (sources at ~Veb -> body effect)
    mn = lut.size("n", p["gmid_n"], p["Ln"], I, vds=0.7, vsb=veb)

    # PMOS mirror (M3, M4, M5)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], p["Lp"], I, vds=0.35)
    pg = VDD - mp.vgs

    # NMOS source follower replaces the PMOS diode: pg = d2 - Vgs7
    mf = lut.size("n", p["gmid_f"], 1.0, p["I7"], vds=VDD - pg, vsb=max(pg, 0.0))
    Rp = max(pg, 0.3) / p["I7"]

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # Left branch: M3 -> M1 (diode) -> Q1
    n.dev("M3", "n1", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "n1", "e1", "vss", mn)
    n.Q("Q1", "vss", "vss", "e1", m=1)
    # Right branch: M4 -> M2 -> R1 -> Q2 (xN)
    n.dev("M4", "d2", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M2", "d2", "n1", "a", "vss", mn)
    n.R("R1", "a", "e2", R1)
    n.Q("Q2", "vss", "vss", "e2", m=N)
    # Follower generating PMOS gate bias
    n.dev("M7", "vdd", "d2", "pg", "vss", mf)
    n.R("Rp", "pg", "vss", Rp)
    n.C("Cpg", "vdd", "pg", 1e-12)
    # Output branch: M5 -> R2 -> Q3
    n.dev("M5", "vref", "pg", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("R2", "vref", "e3", R2)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=1)
    # Start-up: weak pull-up inverter sensing vref, pulls d2 low when vref is low
    n.M("MSP", "sx", "vss", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("MSN", "sx", "vref", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 1.0)
    n.M("MS", "d2", "sx", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 1.0, 0.5)

    vref = veb + p["k_r2"] * dvbe
    itot = 3 * I + p["I7"] + 0.3e-6
    # Line reg: current change via PMOS output conductance, reflected through R2
    line = (mp.gds / max(mp.gm, 1e-12)) * 0.5 + 1e-3
    return n, {
        "vref": vref,
        "tc_ppm": 15.0,
        "power": itot * VDD,
        "line_reg": line,
        "startup_ok": 1,
    }
